question: Let $S=\{1,2,\ldots,n\}$ where $n$ is an odd integer. Let $f$ be a function defined on $\{(i,j):i\in S,j\in S\}$ taking values in $S$ such that (i) $f(s,r)=f(r,s)$ for all $r,s\in S$; (ii) $\{f(r,s):s\in S\}=S$ for all $r\in S$. Show that $\{f(r,r):r\in S\}=S$.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
